label: Anything
scope_note: Anything that exists, happened, or can be referred to. The single top of the kind facet.

label: Thing that persists
scope_note: Something that persists through time while keeping its identity (an object, a place, a group).

label: Physical object
scope_note: A bounded material thing: a rock, a river, a planet, a chair.

label: Substance or material
scope_note: A kind of stuff rather than a bounded thing: water, iron, basalt, DNA.

label: Living organism
scope_note: An individual living being of any kind.

label: Person
scope_note: An individual human being, living or dead, real (fictional persons are 'character').

label: Artifact
scope_note: A physical thing made or modified by people: a tool, a building, a manuscript, a machine.

label: Place
scope_note: A location: a settlement, a region, a natural feature, a site, a place in space.

label: Group or organization
scope_note: A collective of people or organisms that acts or is treated as a unit: a family, a people, a company, a state, a species population.

label: Thing that happens
scope_note: Something that unfolds in time: it has parts that happen at different times.

label: Event
scope_note: A bounded happening: a battle, an eruption, a festival held on a date, a discovery.

label: Process
scope_note: A change that proceeds or recurs: erosion, photosynthesis, urbanization, language change.

label: Practice or activity
scope_note: Something people habitually do: a craft, a ritual, a sport, a method, a way of farming.

label: Abstract thing
scope_note: Something not located in space and time: a number, an idea, a property.

label: Idea, concept or theory
scope_note: A thought-content: a concept, a hypothesis, a theory, a doctrine.

label: Quality or quantity
scope_note: A property of something or a measurable magnitude: mass, colour, temperature, population.

label: Mathematical object
scope_note: A number, set, function, structure or proof.

label: Work or expression
scope_note: A made expression of meaning: a text, an artwork, a piece of music, a film, software, a dataset.

label: Norm or institution
scope_note: A shared rule or institution: a law, a right, a convention, a custom, a standard.

label: Symbol system
scope_note: A system of signs: a language, a script, a notation, a code.

label: Time period
scope_note: A span of time treated as a unit: a century, a dynasty's reign, a geological period.

label: Field of knowledge
scope_note: An organized area of study or knowledge, such as a science, a craft tradition's body of knowledge, or a branch of scholarship.

label: Tradition or worldview
scope_note: A body of beliefs, practices and teachings held by a community: a religion, a philosophy, an ideology.

label: Fictional or legendary character
scope_note: A being that exists within a narrative, myth or tradition (as distinct from a person).
